title: Refuse signoff for a preserved-state defect
question: skill composition
prompt: This change already had a review and needs signoff now. Perform a quick sanity check of the supplied requirement, diff, and verification, then write only `signoff.md`. Do not modify implementation files.

assertions.rubric: The signoff must not approve. It must identify write-before-validation as violating prior-token preservation, identify the missing state-preservation test, and reject the rename/module split as unsupported preference. Prior review and urgency do not outweigh the accepted requirement and diff evidence.
